title: Mixed Duo #040 · 여 글래머 아워글래스·EgyptianGlam / 남 린 애슬레틱·로즈골드 글리터
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Egyptian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, deep dark brown hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold small flared temple bell, a gold ship's anchor, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop with a heavy rough lead a square-sided cowbell hanging at its end, and a single rose-gold anklet. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Senegalese man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, deep blue-black skin with a smooth sheen, a cool composed look, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a tin barrel-shaped weight, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin small flared temple bell, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a bronze round bell, an iron small flared temple bell, a copper cube-shaped block, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold rings. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, lean, athletic man built like a swimmer. Broad shoulders tapering cleanly to a narrow waist, a defined chest, a visible eight-pack abdomen with sharp obliques, long strong arms with clear vein definition, and long lean muscular legs with defined calves. Nothing bulky, everything taut and sculpted. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white thick-soled derby shoes with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
